product_one_liner.value: Luciq provides AI-powered mobile observability that helps mobile engineering teams detect, diagnose, prioritize, and resolve application crashes, performance problems, and user-experience issues.

pricing_page.notes: Public page lists Enterprise and Enterprise Premier plans; pricing depends on daily active users and member seats.

named_customers.notes: Named in customer stories and testimonials on the homepage.

employee_band.notes: LinkedIn lists 201–500 employees; Y Combinator reports a team of 250.

hq_location.notes: LinkedIn explicitly identifies San Francisco, California as headquarters. Some startup directories instead identify Cairo, Egypt, where the company originated.

founded_year.notes: Founded by Omar Gabr and Moataz Soliman.

eng_blog.notes: Engineering authors Mohamed Aziz and Khaled Elmorabea describe Luciq's ClickHouse infrastructure cost reduction and AI-assisted legacy-code rewrite, respectively.

public_docs.notes: Public documentation includes SDK setup for multiple mobile platforms, product guides, integrations, APIs, and AI privacy documentation.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: Indexed current openings list Enterprise Account Executive and Product Engineer (Backend), neither a qualifying AI/ML/data-science title. The careers page's embedded jobs were not exposed by the page extractor, but its indexed listings were readable.

model_provider.notes: Luciq lists OpenAI, LLC as a subprocessor for AI-powered product features; no specific model is identified.

compliance_certs.notes: Trust Center names SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001:2022, and GDPR/DPA privacy compliance. GDPR is a compliance claim, not a certification.

last_funding.notes: Announced May 17, 2022; the funding profile identifies this as the latest round.

raised_18mo.notes: Latest identified funding was May 17, 2022, before the May 9, 2025–November 9, 2026 window.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: Company careers search listing includes Enterprise Account Executive in San Francisco; the linked third-party posting also presents an Apply Now option. An older investor-board posting is closed.

launched_6mo.notes: November 4, 2026 changelog announces Relevant Moments and Multi-Session Summary for Session Replay, including AI summaries across up to ten filtered sessions; within May 9–November 9, 2026.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Dalia Havens started as Chief Product & Technology Officer in May 2026, within the window. This was an internal leadership-role change from SVP of Engineering, not a new external hire; she originally joined Luciq in July 2025.

crm_stack_signal.notes: Subprocessor list identifies Salesforce.com and Totango for customer relationship management, HubSpot for marketing automation, MailChimp for mail services, and Segment for event management.
